page.notes: The line "Consideratio loci iudiciorum sacro-sancti" is split by a brace: "iudices." (ibid.) and "litigantes." (777) belong to the two halves of the same entry; the hyphen across the break is printed. The brace over "Usus ceremonialium legum" gives two sub-entries, "typicarum" (806) and "ordinis" (808). The tree's branch lines were read from the drawing: "injusta" is taken to govern Nabothum and Christum, and "contra" Stephanum and Jacobum Labani. "sanctiū" is doubtful. No page number is printed on this scan.
